title: Carboxy-like structure determines radical scavenging activity of carbon dots for rice resistance to salt stress
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00605H, Paper
Yadong Li, Yunlong Ru, Chunfeng Liao, Xinyue Zhang, Haijiao Xie, Hongjie Wang, Yingliang Liu
The presence of carboxyl functional groups on the surface of carbon dots is significant for their ability to scavenge free radicals and enhance plant resilience to stress conditions.
